method: Deep-research replay derived from the already-frozen 2020Q4 event set. Company evidence, contemporaneous forecasts, and deterministic pre-cutoff hfq regime snapshots are cutoff-bounded; current-model/search leakage remains uncontrolled.
caveats: Current model weights may encode later outcomes.
No post-cutoff selected-stock returns are opened before deep memos lock.
Historical regime uses hfq price series only through the cutoff to avoid negative qfq levels caused by later distributions.
Use as holdout process evidence, not clean forward alpha.
